Order 
Petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of Constitution of India challenging order dated 04/10/2024 by which Collector has refused to refer the matter before Authority.
2. It was ordered that petitioner may approach District Judge and file application there.

Section 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 is quoted as under :-
"64. Reference to Authority.-

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
(1) Any person interested who has not accepted the award may, by written application to the Collector, require that the matter be referred by the Collector for the determination of the Authority, as the case may be,
whether his objection be to the measurement of the land, the amount of the compensation, the person to whom it is payable, the rights of Rehabilitation and Resettlement under Chapters V and VI or the apportionment of the compensation among the persons interested:
Provided that the Collector shall, within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of application, make a reference to the appropriate Authority:

sentences.text:
Provided further that where the Collector fails to make such reference within the period so specified, the applicant may apply to the Authority, as the case may be,
requesting it to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:10052 2 WP-6986-2025 direct the Collector to make the reference to it within a period of thirty days.

Provided further that the Collector may entertain an application after the expiry of the said period, within a further period of one year, if he is satisfied that there was sufficient cause for not filing it within the period specified in the first proviso."

3. As per aforesaid provision if Collector fails to make reference to Authority within a period of 30 days, then aggrieved person can directly file application before Authority, otherwise it is for Collector to refer the matter before Authority.
4. Authority has also refused to entertain the application of petitioners and Collector has dismissed the reference.
In view of same, impugned order dated 04/10/2024 is set aside.
Matter is sent back to Collector for referring it to Authority within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.
5. With the aforesaid direction, petition is disposed off.
